about: Generated from an independent Python model of docs/sync-protocol.md. Every implementation must reproduce these results.

hlc.name: tick advances with wall time and counts within a millisecond
observe raises the clock, later ticks stay ahead

compare.name: null text "null" sorts above a string

merge.name: later wall wins a concurrent rename
fields of one Space merge independently
delete wins over a later field edit
explicit deleted=false with a bigger hlc restores
skew guard: 10 min ahead accepted, beyond rejected and not observed
invalid ops are rejected and do not move the clock
unit category removal is a null register

exchange.name: offline edits on both sides merge both ways
op too far in the future is deferred
invalid initiator ops are rejected and not stored
delete newer than a rename propagates
same hlc: bigger node id wins
same hlc and node: bigger canonical value wins

binding.name: bound by herdr_id even after a rename
rebind by name after Herdr renumbered
no rebind onto a Space whose workspace still exists
peer-hosted and deleted Spaces are not candidates; unbound ones are orphans
two Spaces with the same name: smallest uuid rebinds
name match is exact and case-sensitive
two workspaces with the same label: the first rebinds
a deleted Space is not bound even when its herdr_id matches

hello.name: herdr_version with a semicolon is ignored
herdr_version with a space is ignored
same node id is refused even with herdr_version
proto 2 is refused even with herdr_version
